battle.name: 征服西班尼亞
battle.theater: 安達盧西亞海岸與塞維爾
battle.brief: 553年，查士丁尼一世派貝利撒留自北非出兵伊比利利亞，圍取卡塔赫納，同年於瓜達萊特河擊潰西哥德王提奧德里克二世，554年赫斯帕利斯陷落，殘軍退入盧西塔尼亞山區。帝國奪得安達盧西亞海岸，卻未滅西哥德王國，629年全部撤出。卡面亞述長弓不在場，但其角筋複合弓形制正是兩軍弓兵所用。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亞述人靠弓和鐵的組合征服兩河流域。弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。

countries: 「征服西班尼亞」是六世紀初東羅馬（拜占庭）帝國與西哥德王國在伊比利利亞半島的一場戰爭，主戰期在551至554年，其後以反覆攻防的形式延續了半個多世紀。交戰一方是查士丁尼一世治下的帝國：533年平定蓋薩萊克在東部西班牙的叛亂後，帝國奪回塔拉科納、巴塞羅那、托爾圖薩與那龍比等港口，把西班牙編入教區行省體系，設總督與駐軍，東岸與南岸因此出現一條由帝國掌控的據點帶。553年查士丁尼指派貝利撒留率遠征軍，自北非與撒丁島方向的軍港出發，554年由宦官出身的將領納爾塞斯接手，以收編方式完成對安達盧西亞南岸的接管。另一方是西哥德王國：都城土魯斯，國王提奧德里克（418至551年在位）及其子提奧德里克二世（552至553年在位）先後應戰。王國保留羅馬式行省機構、稅制、拉丁法律與城鎮網絡，國民分為握有土地與軍職的哥特人，以及被編入各類軍團、承擔賦役的羅馬裔居民，貴族騎兵是軍隊骨幹。551年帝國總督馬庫斯一度與法蘭克王基爾德里克一世自北方聯手南下，敗於西哥德人，此事說明三方在西歐互相牽制的實態。西哥德王國在巴埃提卡、盧西塔尼亞、加爾塔吉尼亞斯三省仍握有大量羅馬式城市與山口要塞，故衝突實質是帝國要奪回富庶南岸，王國要保住高原與西部。
countriesEn: The Conquest of Hispania was a war fought on the Iberian peninsula in the early sixth century between the Eastern Roman, or Byzantine, Empire and the Visigothic Kingdom, its main phase running from 551 to 554 and then continuing, in the form of repeated offensives and counter-offensives, for more than half a century. One belligerent was the Empire under Justinian I: after crushing the revolt of Gesalec in the eastern part of Spain in 533, the Empire took back the ports of Tarragona, Barcelona, Tortosa and Narbonne, incorporated Hispania into the provincial system of the diocese, and set up a governor and a garrison, so that a chain of imperial strongholds appeared along the eastern and southern coasts. In 553 Justinian appointed Belisarius to lead an expedition that sailed from the naval bases in North Africa and Sardinia, and in 554 the eunuch-born general Narses took over, completing the takeover of the southern shore by a process of submission rather than of destruction. The other belligerent was the Visigothic Kingdom, with its capital at Toulouse, which faced the Empire first under King Theodoric, reigning from 418 to 551, and then under his son Theodoric II, reigning from 552 to 553. The kingdom kept Roman provincial institutions, taxation, Latin law and a network of towns; its population was divided between Goths who held land and military commands, and Roman-descended residents enrolled in the various units and liable for service and tribute, and the noble cavalry was the backbone of its army. In 551 the imperial governor Marcus marched south in alliance with the Frankish king Childeric I and was beaten by the Visigoths, which shows how the three powers checked one another in the west. The Visigothic Kingdom still held a large number of Roman towns and mountain fortresses in the provinces of Baetica, Lusitania and Carthaginensis, so the substance of the conflict was the Empire's attempt to recover the rich southern shore and the kingdom's determination to keep the plateau and the west.
people: 這場戰爭的關鍵人物分居君士坦丁堡的宮廷與伊比利利亞的戰場兩端。皇帝查士丁尼一世是全部決策的來源：他判定西哥德王國在法理上仍屬帝國版圖，必須收回西班牙，並把剛在西歐取勝的名將貝利撒留與納爾塞斯先後派往半島。西哥德方面的關鍵人物是提奧德里克，他以少年身分在君士坦丁堡生活過，與帝國朝廷往來密切，長期以附庸身分向帝國繳納貢賦；551年他的太子阿吉亞烏爾夫被王族處決，引發宮廷清洗，提奧德里克本人隨後遇刺身亡，王位由其子提奧德里克二世接替，年紀尚幼，國政落在舊臣與地方豪強手中。提奧德里克二世在553年瓜達萊特河一役中率軍出戰而陣亡，成為這場征服戰役中最具決定性的敗績。帝國方面，貝利撒留負責最初的攻堅，他選擇以海路運兵、以圍城消耗而非強求會戰；納爾塞斯接手後不再追求殲滅，而是走遍安達盧西亞各城接受歸降、徵收貢賦。551年與帝國結盟的法蘭克王基爾德里克一世是外來變數，他的介入使提奧德里克得以轉危為安。總督馬庫斯代表帝國在西班牙殘餘的政權，是這個聯盟的另一半。此戰的主要文獻來源是史家普羅科匹烏斯的《戰爭史》，今日所知的多數攻城細節來自他的記載。
peopleEn: The decisive personalities of this war stood at the two ends of the same line, the court at Constantinople and the field in Iberia. The emperor Justinian I was the source of every decision: he held that the Visigothic kingdom was still, in law, part of the imperial patrimony, that Spain had to be recovered, and that the commanders who had just won in the west, Belisarius and Narses, were the men to send to the peninsula. On the Visigothic side the central figure was Theodoric, who had been raised in Constantinople as a boy and kept close relations with the imperial court; for nearly thirty years he ruled as a nominal vassal paying tribute, though he never took the imperial title. In 551 his son Agiaulf was executed by the royal household, a purge of the royal family followed, and Theodoric himself was assassinated; the kingdom then passed to his son Theodoric II, who was still a child, and government fell to the older councillors and the local great families. Theodoric II was killed at the river Guadalete in 553 while leading his army in the field, and that defeat was the turning point of the whole campaign. On the imperial side Belisarius handled the assault: he chose to move his troops by sea and to wear the enemy down by siege rather than to force a general engagement. Narses, who took over in 554, no longer pursued annihilation; he travelled through the towns of Baetica, accepted their submission, and collected the tribute in the regular way. Childeric I of the Franks, who allied with the Empire in 551, was the external variable that allowed Theodoric to recover from the crisis. The governor Marcus represented the last imperial administration in Spain and was the other half of that alliance. The principal literary source for the war is the historian Procopius of Caesarea, from whose account of the Gothic War most of what is known about its operations comes.
kits: 本卡所示的亞述長弓，是新亞述帝國在公元前八至七世紀定型的角筋複合弓：短身、深弓，弓臂以牛角與牛筋分層複合，外覆皮條與漆飾，靠自重與拉力儲存遠射所需的能量。它的形制並不會出現在六世紀的伊比利利亞，但亞述人確立的複合工藝並沒有失傳。晚期古典時代與中世紀早期、定居軍隊與遊牧軍隊所用的短型複合弓，正是沿用角胎配筋身的結構，只是把弦材與護具做得更精緻。當年真正出現在卡塔赫納與赫斯帕利斯周圍的弓，就是這一類：西哥德貴族以騎射立國，馬上所用的角筋弓拉力大，可用於速射與追擊；拜占庭軍中則有成編的足弓手，北非與色雷斯出身的弓手常被編入行軍縱隊，負責掩護步兵方陣與攻城器械的推進。西哥德步兵配短矛、圓盾與劍，騎兵配長槍與刀，雙方都備有鏈甲或鱗甲。攻城一方還要配備撞槌、投石機與配重砲、雲梯，以及保護器械操作班的護板與遮蔽物。維繫全軍的關鍵是馬匹、馱馬、糧食與淡水供應，遠征軍跨越地中海後的補給幾乎全靠船隊。卡面這件亞述長弓本身不在戰場，但它所代表的技術譜系，正是兩軍弓兵手中那把短複合弓。
kitsEn: The Assyrian bow shown on this card is the horn-and-sinew composite bow fixed in its form by the Neo-Assyrian Empire between the eighth and seventh centuries BC: short, deeply curved, built up in layers of horn and sinew, covered with hide and lacquer, and able to store the energy needed for a long shot. No such bow stood in Iberia in the sixth century, but the composite technology the Assyrians established did not disappear. The short composite bow used by the sedentary and steppe armies of late antiquity and the early Middle Ages followed the same construction, pairing a horn belly with a sinew back, with only the string and the fittings refined. The bows actually present around Carthago Nova and Hispalis in these years were of exactly that type. The Visigothic aristocracy was a society of horse archers, and the horn-and-sinew bow carried on horseback had a high draw weight and could be used for rapid shooting and for pursuit. The Byzantine army, for its part, fielded organised foot archers, with men from North Africa and Thrace often taken into the marching column to cover the infantry squares and the working parties of the siege train. Visigothic infantry carried short spears, round shields and swords, and their cavalry had lances and blades; both sides wore mail or scale. The besieging force needed rams, stone-throwers and counterweight artillery, siege towers, and the mantlets and screens that protected the working parties. What held the whole army together was horses, pack mules, grain and fresh water, and after the crossing of the Mediterranean the supply of the expedition depended almost entirely on the fleet. The Assyrian bow on the card never fought in this campaign, but the technical lineage it represents is precisely that of the short composite bows in the hands of the archers on both sides.
tactics: 雙方的作戰方式在這幾年裡完全不同。551年提奧德里克面對馬庫斯與基爾德里克聯軍時，選擇在都城西南的平原上迎戰：聯軍的騎兵衝鋒被西哥德騎兵以射擊與縱深反擊挫敗，聯軍隨即潰散，提奧德里克反手圍攻那龍比，把帝國在東南的最後一批守軍與城內居民驅回高盧。553年貝利撒留改採另一條路線：船隊自北非出發，沿海北上，在加爾塔吉尼亞斯的海灣登陸，遠征軍不與西哥德騎兵爭奪中原戰場，而是直取海港與要道，用圍城切斷城市之間的聯繫。第一場硬仗是卡塔赫納，遠征軍以配重砲與撞槌攻擊城牆，守軍在缺糧與水源告急時屢次出城反擊，帝國軍以盾陣與攻城器械應戰，圍城最終以守軍崩潰收場。554年遠征軍西進至赫斯帕利斯，要求守軍歸降未果，隨即包圍全城並封鎖河道，守軍在長期圍困中以突擊消耗帝國前線，帝國軍則以輪番替換與遠程器械壓制缺口，最終攻破城門。西哥德殘部退入盧西塔尼亞與加利西亞的山區，遠征軍追入山中卻無法驅散依託山寨與部族支持的殘軍。納爾塞斯接手後放棄會戰與追擊，改為巡行各地城鎮、接受歸降、按制度徵收貢賦，並以海路封鎖沿海據點。
tacticsEn: The two sides fought in entirely different ways during these years. In 551, facing the coalition of Marcus and Childeric, Theodoric chose to meet it in the plain to the south-west of his capital: the cavalry charge of the coalition was broken by Visigothic shooting and counter-charge, the coalition broke up, and Theodoric turned the tables by besieging Narbonne, driving the last imperial garrison and the townspeople back into Gaul. In 553 Belisarius took a different road. The fleet sailed out of North Africa, ran up the coast and landed in the bay of Carthago Nova. The expedition did not seek a general engagement with the Visigothic horse on the plains; it struck at the ports and the roads, cutting the towns off from one another by siege. The first hard-fought case was Carthago Nova, where the besiegers worked the walls with counterweight artillery and rams while the garrison, short of food and water, made repeated sorties that the imperial troops met behind their shields and around the siege engines. The siege ended when the garrison collapsed. In 554 the column moved west to Hispalis. The demand for surrender was refused, the city was invested, and the river was closed to it; the defenders spent the long blockade in sorties that wore down the imperial front, and the besiegers replied with rotated units and artillery that dominated every breach, until the gate was forced. The Visigothic remnants fell back into the mountains of Lusitania and Gallaecia, and the expedition pursued them into the hills without being able to dislodge a resistance that rested on strongholds and tribal support. When Narses took over he abandoned the general engagement and the pursuit, and instead moved from town to town accepting submission, levying the tribute in the regular way, and sealing the coastal positions by sea.
data: 可核對的時間點大致如下：551年，提奧德里克的太子阿吉亞烏爾夫被處決，馬庫斯與基爾德里克的聯軍自北方南下並在都城附近被擊敗，提奧德里克隨後遇刺；552年西哥德朝廷混亂，帝國完成義大利戰爭並把貝利撒留調離半島戰線；553年遠征軍在卡塔赫納登陸，圍城數月後取城，同年瓜達萊特河一役西哥德王提奧德里克二世陣亡；554年赫斯帕利斯陷落，殘軍退入盧西塔尼亞山區；555年納爾塞斯返意大利，接替南岸各城的歸降與貢賦安排；約561年帝國與西哥德王國達成和解與同盟，內容包括西哥德方面按年繳納黃金，普羅科匹烏斯記載的數字為每年一千磅；568年西哥德王國把都城由土魯斯遷往托萊多；585至587年國王阿吉盧爾夫奪回被帝國佔有的東岸港市；621至625年帝國一度收復部分城市，624年西哥德王西塞南再奪加爾塔吉尼亞；629年帝國放棄西班牙，全部撤出。地理上，卡塔赫納至赫斯帕利斯約三百公里，赫斯帕利斯位於瓜達基維爾河下游，瓜達萊特河在其西南約三十公里處入海，盧西塔尼亞山區在正西方向。兩軍的具體人數在史料中沒有可靠記載，遠征軍的規模只能從禁衛騎兵、步兵、弓手與攻城器械的編制推知。戰爭的確切起始月份亦無記載，卡面所標的月份屬一般推定。
dataEn: The points that can be checked run roughly as follows. In 551 Agiaulf, the son of Theodoric, was executed, Marcus and Childeric marched south from the north and were beaten near the capital, and Theodoric was assassinated soon afterwards; in 552 the Visigothic court was in confusion, while the Empire finished the Italian war and released Belisarius from that front; in 553 the expedition landed at Carthago Nova and took the city after a siege of several months, and in the same year Theodoric II was killed at the Guadalete; in 554 Hispalis fell and the survivors withdrew into the mountains of Lusitania; in 555 Narses returned to Italy after arranging the submission and the tribute of the southern towns; around 561 the Empire and the Visigothic kingdom concluded a peace and an alliance whose terms included an annual payment of gold from the Visigoths, recorded by Procopius as a thousand pounds of gold a year; in 568 the Visigothic kingdom moved its capital from Toulouse to Toledo; between 585 and 587 King Agilulf recovered the eastern ports held by the Empire; between 621 and 625 the Empire briefly retook several towns, and in 624 King Sisenand took Carthaginensis again; in 629 the Empire gave up Spain entirely and withdrew. Geographically, Carthago Nova lies about three hundred kilometres from Hispalis, which stands on the lower Guadalquivir; the Guadalete flows into the sea some thirty kilometres to the south-west of it, and the mountains of Lusitania lie due to the west. There is no reliable figure for the size of either army in the sources, and the strength of the expedition can only be inferred from the composition of the imperial guard cavalry, the infantry, the archers and the siege train. The exact month in which the war began is likewise not recorded, and the month shown on the card is a general estimate.
cause: 起因是查士丁尼一世的帝國復興政策與西哥德王國的附庸地位同時走到盡頭。526年西哥德王阿馬拉松塔死後，其子提奧德里克在君士坦丁堡的監護下即位，與帝國維持和平與納貢關係近三十年，卻始終拒絕採用帝國的稱號；在查士丁尼看來，未經皇帝冊封而自行統治西班牙的行省，本身即是必須剝奪的違例。533年蓋薩萊克在東部西班牙起兵反叛，帝國趁機收回東岸港口，證明只要有機會，帝國軍便能登陸作戰；此後那龍比與塔拉科納一帶的爭端反覆，雙方在邊境線上不斷試探。551年的王位危機是直接的導火線：太子阿吉亞烏爾夫被處決造成王族內鬥，總督馬庫斯乘機聯合法蘭克人自北方壓境，雖被擊敗，卻證明王國的處境脆弱。553年查士丁尼在義大利戰事結束後把貝利撒留調往西班牙，理由是光復被哥特人佔有的西部行省。宗教並非主因：兩個政權同屬迦克墩信經，衝突不涉及信仰分歧，而是版圖與權威之爭。
causeEn: The cause was the meeting of Justinian I's policy of restoration with the exhausted vassalage of the Visigothic kingdom. When Amalasuntha died in 526, her son Theodoric, raised under imperial supervision in Constantinople, came to the throne, and for nearly thirty years the kingdom lived in peace and paid tribute to the Empire, yet it never adopted the imperial title; in Justinian's eyes a province governed without a grant from the emperor was a province that had to be taken back. The revolt of Gesalec in the eastern part of Spain in 533 gave the Empire its chance to recover the eastern ports and proved that an imperial army could land and fight; the disputes over Narbonne and Tarragona then resumed, and both sides probed the frontier line. The crisis of the succession in 551 was the immediate trigger: the execution of the crown prince Agiaulf opened a rift inside the royal house, and the governor Marcus took advantage of it by bringing the Franks down from the north; although that coalition was defeated, it had shown how exposed the kingdom was. In 553, after the Italian war had ended, Justinian transferred Belisarius to Spain on the ground that the western provinces occupied by the Goths had to be recovered. Religion was not the cause: both polities held to the Chalcedonian definition, and the quarrel was about territory and authority, not about belief.
impact: 短期的結果是帝國在伊比利利亞插上一支釘子，也讓西哥德王國明白海疆無法再視為屏障。拜占庭在南岸建立卡塔赫納與赫斯帕利斯兩個立足點，與533年已取的東岸據點相連，形成一條不連續的海岸線，帝國海軍得以控制巴利阿里海峽的航路，主導西地中海的航運。從財政看，帝國在西班牙的所得並不巨大，但安達盧西亞的糧食與港口帶來實際利益，使遠征在帳面上可以成立。西哥德方面的損失則是致命的：兩位國王相繼戰死，王國失去安達盧西亞平原的稅收收入與羅馬城市，被迫退向盧西塔尼亞、加利西亞的部族地區與山地。長期看，這場戰爭反而促成西哥德王國與帝國的長期合作：561年的和約把王國綁上拜占庭對法蘭克人的戰線，568年都城遷往托萊多，把政治重心移回伊比利利亞半島腹地，589年的托萊多會議確立正統信仰的統一地位，兩套法律與土地制度的融合最終保存於《胡爾戈判例法》等中世紀法典之中。
impactEn: In the short term the war planted a nail in the Iberian peninsula and taught the Visigothic kingdom that the sea coast could no longer be treated as a barrier. The Empire established two footholds on the southern shore, at Carthago Nova and Hispalis; together with the eastern points seized in 533 these formed an interrupted line of coast along which the imperial navy could control the passage through the Balearic Sea and dominate the shipping of the western Mediterranean. Financially the Empire's gain from Spain was not large, but the grain and the harbours of Baetica brought real benefit, and on the books the expedition could be made to pay. The Visigothic losses were far more serious: two kings fell in the field, the kingdom lost the plains of Baetica with their taxes and their Roman towns, and was pushed back into the tribal country and the highlands of Lusitania and Gallaecia. In the long run the war encouraged a durable partnership between the kingdom and the Empire: the peace of 561 attached the Visigoths to the Byzantine war against the Franks, the transfer of the capital to Toledo in 568 moved the centre of gravity into the interior of the peninsula, and the council of Toledo in 589 confirmed the position of the single orthodoxy, while the fusion of the two legal and land systems was later preserved in codes such as the Fuero Juzgo.
result: 帝國的戰役在戰術上是成功的，在戰略上卻只完成了一半。553至554年間，卡塔赫納與赫斯帕利斯相繼陷落，提奧德里克二世陣亡，納爾塞斯接管南岸各城的歸降，帝國在安達盧西亞取得據點，並在約561年把西哥德王國綁進對法蘭克人的同盟。這條海岸線維持了大約七十年，期間拜占庭的西班牙總督一度由宦官蘇波斯與執事凱撒里奧斯率軍深入內陸，624年又被西塞南在加爾塔吉尼亞擊退，直到629年帝國才完全放棄這片飛地，最後一批守軍撤回北非。西哥德王國沒有被消滅：它放棄了南方富庶的平原，改以托萊多為核心重建統治，把安達盧西亞與加利西亞的山區部族納入版圖，在585至587年先後奪回東岸港市，並在七、八世紀之交轉為對外的天主教王國。帝國的遠征最終只換來一條維持數十年的海岸線，卻在中原留下了一個更鞏固、更具凝聚力的西哥德國家。
resultEn: Imperial victory in this campaign was tactical rather than strategic, and it amounted to half a conquest. Between 553 and 554 Carthago Nova and Hispalis fell in turn, Theodoric II was killed, Narses took the submission of the southern towns, the Empire gained a position on the coast of Baetica, and by about 561 it had tied the Visigothic kingdom into its own alliance against the Franks. That coastline lasted about seventy years. In the interval the governors of Byzantine Spain, at times the eunuch Suppos and the patrician Caesarius, drove inland, but in 624 Sisenand threw them out of Carthaginensis, and in 629 the Empire finally abandoned the province and the last garrison withdrew to North Africa. The Visigothic kingdom was not destroyed: it gave up the wealthy plains of the south, rebuilt its rule around Toledo, drew the tribal districts of Baetica and Gallaecia into the kingdom, took back the eastern ports between 585 and 587, and turned in the eighth century into a Catholic kingdom with a foreign policy of its own. The expedition bought the Empire a coastal strip that lasted a few decades and, on the continent, a Visigothic state more solid and more cohesive than the one it had attacked.
